facts.value: O.C.G.A. 34-4-3(b)-(c) (Ga. L. 2001, p. 201, Act 32): the chapter does not apply to employers with sales of 40,000 USD per year or less; employers having five employees or less; employers of domestic employees; farm owners, sharecroppers or land renters; employees paid wholly or partially in gratuities; high school or college students; newspaper carriers; individuals employed by a nonprofit child-caring institution or long-term care facility serving children or mentally disabled adults who reside there, receive board and lodging without cost and are paid in cash at least 10,000 USD per year; nor to an employer subject to a higher federal minimum wage as to the employees it covers.
